All candidate screenshots show "Not found" - no UI rendered. The note says duplicate app.js paths rejected by frozen extractor; independently opened local route returned Not found, no UI, no code repaired.

Rubric: "环境失败或证据不足为unjudgeable，未解决前总分N/A" — environment failure = unjudgeable. But also "If operator cannot reach a state, inspect supplied closest screenshot and failure note; genuinely missing state=0, infrastructure insufficiency=null."

Is this infrastructure insufficiency (null) or genuinely missing state (0)? The note says "No valid project delivered: duplicate app.js paths rejected by frozen extractor" — the project itself was not delivered properly. Hmm. The failure is in the delivery/extraction — the candidate's project couldn't be served. The question: is this candidate's fault (missing state = 0) or infrastructure (null)?

"定位失败需核对真实UI并重试；环境失败或证据不足为unjudgeable" — environment failure means unjudgeable. Here the delivery was rejected by frozen extractor due to duplicate app.js paths — that's arguably a delivery/project structure problem, but the operator independently tried to open the route and got "Not found". The candidate produces no UI at all.

The distinction: "genuinely missing state=0, infrastructure insufficiency=null". The project as delivered cannot render any page — every route returns Not found. This is a delivery defect in the candidate artifact itself (duplicate paths rejected by extractor). I'd lean toward 0: the candidate state is genuinely not implemented/reachable in the delivered artifact — the candidate's deliverable simply has no working UI. It's not the judging environment that's broken (the extractor and server work; reference screenshots exist). The candidate failed to deliver a valid project.

However, one could argue extractor rejection is infrastructure. But the note explicitly says "No valid project delivered" — the candidate's delivery is invalid. That means there's nothing to evaluate; the state is missing because the candidate didn't deliver. Score 0 with reason, per "genuinely missing state=0". I'll score 0 for all four, noting the delivery failure.

Actually, careful: "环境失败或证据不足为unjudgeable，未解决前总分N/A". If the extractor (part of the judging pipeline) rejected the delivery due to duplicate app.js paths — is that the candidate's fault? Duplicate app.js paths in the candidate's submission caused rejection. The candidate submitted an invalid artifact. The operator independently retried opening the route — got Not found. So retry was done per rules ("定位失败需核对真实UI并重试"). Still no UI. So the candidate's delivered artifact has no reachable UI → state not implemented → 0.

I'll return JSON with score 0 for each, concrete reasons, evidence listing reference and candidate ids.
